cell_wall.name: Cell Wall (Cellulose)
cell_wall.description: Rigid, non-living outer protective layer composed of cellulose microfibrils that maintains cell shape and prevents osmotic lysis.

plasma_membrane.name: Plasma Membrane (Cell Membrane)
plasma_membrane.description: Selectively permeable phospholipid bilayer with embedded transport proteins regulating the entry and exit of solutes.

chloroplast.name: Chloroplast (Thylakoids & Stroma)
chloroplast.description: Double-membraned photosynthetic organelle containing chlorophyll pigments in disc-like thylakoids (grana) for carbohydrate synthesis.

large_central_vacuole.name: Large Central Vacuole (Cell Sap)
large_central_vacuole.description: Prominent fluid-filled internal reservoir storing water, mineral salts, and organic compounds, generating internal turgor pressure.

tonoplast.name: Tonoplast (Vacuolar Membrane)
tonoplast.description: Selectively permeable single lipid bilayer bounding the central vacuole that maintains cell turgidity through active transport.

cytoplasm.name: Cytoplasm (Cytosol)
cytoplasm.description: Jelly-like aqueous colloidal ground substance where metabolic enzymatic reactions occur and organelles are suspended.

nucleus.name: Nucleus (Chromatin & Nuclear Envelope)
nucleus.description: Spherical double-membrane bounded control center housing genetic information (DNA in chromatin fibers) and controlling protein synthesis.

nucleolus.name: Nucleolus
nucleolus.description: Dense, dark-staining sub-nuclear body responsible for transcribing ribosomal RNA (rRNA) and assembling ribosome subunits.

endoplasmic_reticulum.name: Endoplasmic Reticulum (Rough & Smooth)
endoplasmic_reticulum.description: Interconnected labyrinth of membranous cisternae; rough ER is studded with ribosomes for protein synthesis, while smooth ER synthesizes lipids.

mitochondrion.name: Mitochondrion (Cristae & Matrix)
mitochondrion.description: Double-membraned powerhouse organelle with folded inner cristae responsible for aerobic cellular respiration and ATP generation.

golgi_apparatus.name: Golgi Apparatus (Golgi Body)
golgi_apparatus.description: Stack of flattened curved cisternae that chemically modifies, sorts, and packages glycoproteins and lipids into secretory vesicles.
